mostWorthwhile.text: Spreading fat with bile and then using enzymes was most worthwhile: it showed that making smaller droplets and breaking molecules are different jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Breaking protein down was the least engaging moment because enzymes had already broken down fat and starch, and it was the only available combination.

surprise.text: I didn't expect saliva to leave shorter starch chains that needed another enzyme step before becoming separate glucose units.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the pictures and goals explained the pairings, although the compatible-options menu guided the choices.

continue.text: I might continue: seeing how the glucose and amino acids cross the gut lining would be interesting, though the repeated enzyme combinations were less engaging.
